children: announced that board chair Donna James has decided not to stand for re-election at the company's annual meeting. James has served as chair since the women's retailer became an independent public company in 2021.
As part of the ongoing succession planning process, the board has unanimously elected independent director Rod Little, CEO of Edgewell Personal Care Company

, to succeed James, effective following the 2027 annual meeting, subject to his reelection by shareholders. James will continue to serve as chair through the conclusion of her current term, and she and Little will work closely together over the coming months to ensure a seamless transition.
